other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Jammu & Kashmir and registered with Mission Youth
Youth group must have at least 3 members
All members must have at least 12th standard qualification (relaxable on case‑by‑case basis)
Preference is given to groups registered as Self‑Help Groups, Registered Society, or Registered Trust
No member should have previously benefited under any self‑employment or similar government scheme
Police must certify the character antecedents of all group members
Applicants must not be defaulters to any bank or financial institution
Group must be certified by a competent authority
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹20 lakh, comprising a minimum ₹2.5 lakh (or 10% of project cost) subsidy and a bank loan covering up to 70% of project cost, with the subsidy capped at ₹5 lakh per case.
